title: Electronic band structure of low-temperature YB12, YB6 superconductors and layered YB2, MgB2 diborides
abstract: Electronic band structure of boron-rich low-temperature superconductors UB12-like dodecaboride YB12 and CaB6-like hexaboride YB6 are investigated using the first-principle FLMTO calculations and compared with one for layered YB2 and the new "medium-Tc" superconductor MgB2 diborides.
